"Symobilic" -> "Symbolic"
"iteself" -> "itself"
"reqeust" -> "request"
"nvme_wait_on_comand" -> "nvme_wait_on_command"
"bount" -> "bound"
"captrue_mask" -> "capture_mask"

..and also unwrap a line to fix a checkpatch warning.
